diagnostic_kind: training-set memorisation / capacity; NO held-out population, NO generalization claim

subset.selection: seeded permutation within each frozen Phase 1A frequency band, NOT the head of the ranking
subset.nested: per-band ordering is independent of subset size, so a larger subset is a strict superset by construction

budget.optimizer: AdamW, fresh, task scope only; checkpoint optimizer state never restored
budget.stopping: predeclared training-set acquisition criterion at N consecutive scheduled evaluations, or budget exhaustion

populations.sampler: uniform over the subset, one full pass per step
populations.retrieval_note: bank NOT shrunk to the subset: retrieval stays a full-lexicon-way decision

repetition.note: DEFERRED: the LTM repetition consequence is already established by Phase 2B and 2C1; this pass dominates wall time and is not needed to decide subset capacity. The canonical evaluator is unmodified, only unused.

staged_init.note: STAGED start: model weights only. A fresh AdamW is built over the N0 scope, so this is NOT an exact continuation of the source run's optimization trajectory.

forgetting.landmarks_note: descriptive forgetting landmarks, NOT success criteria

union.derivation: exact size-weighted mean of two disjoint populations
